name: chat-history
description: A deep-red dot in the prompt footer that opens this project's past conversations, click one to resume it like claude -r.

showDot.title: Show the history dot
showDot.description: Draw the dot in the prompt footer line.

pageSize.title: Conversations per page
pageSize.description: How many rows the history pane lists at once.

showAllProjects.title: List every project
showAllProjects.description: List conversations from every project folder, not only this one. Only this project's can be resumed in place.

previewLines.title: Preview lines
previewLines.description: How many messages of the highlighted conversation to show.
